product_metadata.title: mDesign Decorative Kitchen Plastic Sink Protector Set, Quick Draining - Protect Surfaces and Dishes - Modern Bubble Design - Includes 1 Saddle, 2 Large Mats - Set of 3 - Amber/Brown
features: SCRATCH FREE SINKS: Sink saddle and sink mats keep kitchen sinks clean and scratch free; Perfect for double sink basins; Made of heavy, flexible plastic, the mats stay in place at the bottom of the sink to protect sink surfaces from scratches; The sink saddle is also made of flexible heavy and durable plastic to keep it secure on the sink divider; Pack of 3

PROTECT DISHES & SINK: Provides a soft cushion for delicate dishes, glassware, wine glasses, bowls, cups and tableware, serve ware, coffee mugs and more during washing; Provides protection to sinks - prevent scratching and marring so your sinks always look their best; These are also great for use in utility sinks and tubs in laundry rooms and garages

SUPERIOR DRAINAGE: The pattern is designed with spaces in between to allow water to flow through quickly and easily while washing and rinsing dishes; Section can also be cut away from the sink mats to create a hole for center or side drains - it's easy to customize to fit your sink
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of durable soft BPA free flexible PVC plastic; Holds up to daily usage; Easy Care - clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Each Sink Mat Measures: 15.5" x 12" x .2" high; Sink Saddle Measures: 10.3" x 2" x 5" high; Saddle fits over sink dividers up to 1.8" / 4.5cm thick
